#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Convert customer_report.docx to PDF and email it to bob@example.com.

Requirements:
  - LibreOffice installed (for DOCX→PDF conversion)
  - Python 3.6+
  - No extra pip packages needed (uses stdlib only)

Configuration:
  Update the SMTP_* variables below to match your mail server.
"""

import subprocess
import smtplib
import sys
import os
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DOCX_PATH = "/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx"
OUTPUT_DIR = "/workspace/testbed/docs"  # PDF will be saved alongside the .docx

SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com"   # ← update with your SMTP server
SMTP_PORT = 587                  # 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SSL
SMTP_USER = "you@example.com"    # ← update with your credentials
SMTP_PASS = "your_password"      # ← update (or use env var below)
# Alternatively, set env vars to avoid hardcoding credentials:
#   SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS

FROM_ADDR = "you@example.com"    # ← sender address
TO_ADDR   = "bob@example.com"
SUBJECT   = "Customer Report"
BODY      = (
    "Hi Bob,\n\n"
    "Please find the latest customer report attached as a PDF.\n\n"
    "Best regards"
)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def load_config():
    """Override config from environment variables if set."""
    global SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, FROM_ADDR
    SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", SMTP_HOST)
    SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", SMTP_PORT))
    SMTP_USER = os.environ.get("SMTP_USER", SMTP_USER)
    SMTP_PASS = os.environ.get("SMTP_PASS", SMTP_PASS)
    FROM_ADDR = os.environ.get("FROM_ADDR", FROM_ADDR)


def convert_docx_to_pdf(docx_path: str, output_dir: str) -> str:
    """Convert a .docx file to PDF using LibreOffice and return the PDF path."""
    docx = Path(docx_path)
    if not docx.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: Source file not found: {docx_path}")

    print(f"Converting {docx.name} to PDF ...")
    result = subprocess.run(
        [
            "libreoffice",
            "--headless",
            "--convert-to", "pdf",
            "--outdir", output_dir,
            str(docx),
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )

    if result.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(
            f"LibreOffice conversion failed (exit {result.returncode}):\n"
            f"{result.stderr}"
        )

    pdf_path = Path(output_dir) / docx.with_suffix(".pdf").name
    if not pdf_path.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: Expected PDF not found at {pdf_path}")

    print(f"PDF created: {pdf_path}  ({pdf_path.stat().st_size:,} bytes)")
    return str(pdf_path)


def send_email(pdf_path: str):
    """Send an email with the PDF attached via SMTP."""
    pdf = Path(pdf_path)

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"]    = FROM_ADDR
    msg["To"]      = TO_ADDR
    msg["Subject"] = SUBJECT
    msg.set_content(BODY)

    # Attach the PDF
    with open(pdf, "rb") as f:
        msg.add_attachment(
            f.read(),
            maintype="application",
            subtype="pdf",
            filename=pdf.name,
        )

    print(f"Sending email to {TO_ADDR} via {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT} ...")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server:
        server.ehlo()
        server.starttls()
        server.ehlo()
        server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS)
        server.send_message(msg)

    print("Email sent successfully!")


def main():
    load_config()
    pdf_path = convert_docx_to_pdf(DOCX_PATH, OUTPUT_DIR)
    send_email(pdf_path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
